question: India Post Launches IT 2.0 – Advanced Postal Technology to Drive Digital Transformation Nationwide. Which cloud platform supports the IT 2.0 system in India Post?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**MeghRaj 2.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Post Launches IT 2.0 – Advanced Postal Technology to Drive Digital Transformation Nationwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India Post** has rolled out **IT 2.0** — **Advanced Postal Technology (APT)**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative is led under the **vision of Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya M. Scindia**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Centre for Excellence in Postal Technology** developed the system, running on **MeghRaj 2.0 cloud**.

 
 
• 
 
**BSNL's nationwide connectivity** supports the new system.

 
 
• 
 
**Next-generation features** include **unified interface**, **QR-code-based payments**, **OTP-based delivery**, and a **10-digit alphanumeric DIGIPIN**.
